import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class edge {
        int to, rev, f, cap;
        edge(int to, int rev, int f, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.f = f;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class pair {
        int first, second;
        pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class queue {
        int[] data;
        int front, rear;
        queue(int capacity) {
            data = new int[capacity];
            front = rear = 0;
        }
        boolean isEmpty() {
            return front == rear;
        }
        boolean isFull() {
            return rear == data.length - 1;
        }
        void enqueue(int value) {
            if (isFull()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Queue is full");
            }
            data[rear++] = value;
        }
        int dequeue() {
            if (isEmpty()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
            }
            return data[front++];
        }
    }

    static class grid {
        int[][] data;
        grid(int n, int m) {
            data = new int[n][m];
        }
        void fill(int value) {
            for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(data[i], value);
            }
        }
    }

    static class pairQueue {
        pair[] data;
        int front, rear;
        pairQueue(int capacity) {
            data = new pair[capacity];
            front = rear = 0;
        }
        boolean isEmpty() {
            return front == rear;
        }
        boolean isFull() {
            return rear == data.length - 1;
        }
        void enqueue(pair value) {
            if (isFull()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Queue is full");
            }
            data[rear++] = value;
        }
        pair dequeue() {
            if (isEmpty()) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Queue is empty");
            }
            return data[front++];
        }
    }

    static int MAXN = 300;
    static int INF = 1000000000;

    static int[][] dis;
    static int[] ptr;
    static int src, dst;

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, -1);
        dis[src] = 0;
        queue q = new queue(MAXN);
        q.enqueue(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty() && dis[dst] == -1) {
            int u = q.dequeue();
            for (edge e : adj[u]) {
                int v = e.to;
                if (dis[v] == -1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + 1;
                    q.enqueue(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dis[dst] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int f) {
        if (u == dst || f == 0)
            return f;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); i++) {
            edge e = adj[u][i];
            int v = e.to;
            if (dis[v] != dis[u] + 1)
                continue;
            if (int df = dfs(v, Math.min(f, e.cap - e.f))) {
                e.f += df;
                adj[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                return df;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int mf() {
        int res = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (int df = dfs(src, INF))
                res += df;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 1, 0};

    static int n, m;
    static grid obs, tim, dii;
    static String[] lab, rea;

    static void gbfs(int r, int c, grid dis, boolean chk) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], -1);
        dis[r][c] = 0;
        pairQueue q = new pairQueue(MAXN);
        q.enqueue(new pair(r, c));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            pair p = q.dequeue();
            if (chk && dis[p.first][p.second] == tim[p.first][p.second])
                continue;
            pair r;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                r = new pair(p.first + dx[i], p.second + dy[i]);
                if (r.first < 0 || r.first >= n || r.second < 0 || r.second >= n || dis[r.first][r.second] != -1 || obs[r.first][r.second])
                    continue;
                if (chk && tim[r.first][r.second] > -1 && dis[p.first][p.second] + 1 > tim[r.first][r.second])
                    continue;
                dis[r.first][r.second] = dis[p.first][p.second] + 1;
                q.enqueue(r);
            }
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<edge>> adj;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        lab = new String[n];
        rea = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            lab[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            rea[i] = br.readLine();
        obs = new grid(n, n);
        tim = new grid(n, n);
        dii = new grid(n, n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                obs.data[i][j] = (lab[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (lab[i].charAt(j) == 'Z')
                    gbfs(i, j, tim.data);
        src = 2 * n * n + 5;
        dst = src + 1;
        adj = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n * n + n * n + 2; i++)
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (lab[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || lab[x].charAt(y) == 'Y')
                    continue;
                adj.get(src).add(new edge(n * x + y, adj.get(n * x + y).size(), 0, lab[x].charAt(y) - '0'));
                adj.get(n * n + n * x + y).add(new edge(dst, adj.get(dst).size(), 0, rea[x].charAt(y) - '0'));
                gbfs(x, y, dii.data, true);
                for (int xp = 0; xp < n; xp++) {
                    for (int yp = 0; yp < n; yp++) {
                        if (dii.data[xp][yp] != -1 && dii.data[xp][yp] <= m) {
                            adj.get(n * x + y).add(new edge(n * n + n * xp + yp, adj.get(n * n + n * xp + yp).size(), 0, INF));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        dis = new int[n * n + n * n + 2][];
        for (int i = 0; i < dis.length; i++)
            dis[i] = new int[1];
        ptr = new int[n * n + n * n + 2];
        System.out.println(mf());
    }
